title: Implementation of deep learning-based gauze detection in pancreatic laparoscopic and robotic surgery: an exploratory multicenter evaluation
summary: A YOLOv3 variant detects gauze in 581 surgical videos/296,127 frames from five centers; multisite training improved sensitivity/precision (84.70%/79.58% baseline to 89.76%/81.03%), with real-time testing at 29.04 ms/frame. Authors frame this as exploratory multicenter assessment. The result is reported in the Artificial Intelligence Surgery. It does not establish generalization beyond the reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: Modified YOLOv3 detects gauze in laparoscopic/robotic video and supports real-time tracking.
